comment: Operator library manifest (#663). Each entry maps a (op_kind, tier, dtype) triple to a compiled SASS blob. The blob path is resolved relative to this manifest's directory. Update this file when adding a new operator/tier/dtype variant; keep in lockstep with enum slm_gpu_op_kind / SLM_GPU_TIER_* / enum slm_gpu_dtype in kernel/include/gpu_handoff.h.

entries.comment: Today's CUDA-core FP32 GEMM. Reads M/K/N from cbuf at dispatch time. Source: scripts/cuda/gemm_fp32.cu.
Direct (no im2col) FP32 conv. Source: scripts/cuda/conv2d_fp32_direct.cu. The HMMA tier-1 sibling for this op landed in #674 (see CONV2D.HMMA.FP16 below).
Add per-channel bias, optional ReLU via launcher cbuf flag. Source: scripts/cuda/add_bias_relu_fp32.cu.
Spatial max pooling. Reads kernel/stride from cbuf. Source: scripts/cuda/maxpool2d_fp32.cu.

FP16/FP16 → FP32 tensor-core GEMM via nvcuda::wmma m16n16k16 (lowers to mma.sync.m16n8k16 on sm_87 GA10B). Reads M/K/N from cbuf at dispatch time, same scalar layout as the SIMT FP32 entry — the launcher just swaps the shader. Source: scripts/cuda/gemm_hmma_fp16.cu (#659/#673).

Implicit-GEMM 2D convolution on tensor cores. Reformulates conv as (K_out, C_in·R·S, N_batch·H_out·W_out) GEMM and computes the im2col B-matrix gather in-shader (no DRAM staging). Source: scripts/cuda/conv2d_hmma_fp16.cu (#662/#674).

Q4_K → FP16 dequantizer. One CUDA block per 144-byte super-block, 256 threads each materializing one FP16 output. Mirrors runtime/src/inference/quant.rs::dequant_q4k_block bit-for-bit (validated against CPU reference on Jetson sm_87 across 1/32/128 super-block harness). First SLM-shaped entry in the operator library; usable as a standalone weight-materialization step and as a stepping-stone before the fused Q4K_DOT / Q4K_GEMM kernels land. Source: scripts/cuda/q4k_dequant_f16.cu (#540).

Per-row root-mean-square layer norm in FP16 with FP32 accumulator. One CUDA block per row, 256 threads per block — strided sum-of-squares + tree reduction → rsqrtf → strided write of x * rms_inv * gamma. Mirrors runtime/src/inference/ops_transformer.rs::rmsnorm; matches the CPU reference within 2 ULPs across Qwen2.5-1.5B (1×1536, 16×1536), Llama-2 (1×4096), and a non-multiple-of-256 tail (1×768). Source: scripts/cuda/rmsnorm_f16.cu (#540).

future_entries.comment: Add these when their kernels land. Documented here so the manifest reads as a roadmap, not a punch-list.
future_entries.GEMM_GENERIC.HMMA.FP32A_FP16W: from #661/#676 — gemm_hmma_fp32a_fp16w_shader.sass. Mixed-precision (FP32 activation × FP16 weight) GEMM used by the MNIST FC layer when it has to consume an FP32 pool2 output. Schema gap: today's (op_kind, tier, dtype) triple can't express the activation-vs-weight precision split — needs a schema bump (separate `act_dtype` + `weight_dtype` fields, or a packed dtype-pair encoding) before this can move into `entries`. The MNIST launcher (scripts/gpu-kernel-mnist.c) loads the SASS directly via --shader-dir today, bypassing the operator library, so this is dormant until the schema lands.
future_entries.Q4K_DOT.SIMT.Q4K: future SLM-on-GPU work — fused dequantize + matmul, lighter on bandwidth than Q4K_DEQUANT followed by GEMM_GENERIC. Q4K_DEQUANT (above) is the standalone unpacker; Q4K_DOT will inline that unpack into the matmul inner loop.
future_entries.GEMM_GENERIC.HMMA.BF16: tensor-core BF16 if a target model wants it
future_entries.GEMM_GENERIC.IMMA.INT8: future quantized matmul on tensor cores
